info.title: Echo Agent Platform API
info.description:
Autonomous AI Agent Platform runtime, mission execution engine, skills, features, and model proxy API.

Triggers autonomous agent execution loops using configurable LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, LM Studio, OpenCode Go) with full tool-calling, memory, and streaming support.

get.description: Fetch the implemented tool registry — the feature IDs the agent can actually execute, dynamically derived from the tool registry. Each entry maps a requestable feature id to its loaded tool name and description. Catalog metadata (tier_requirement, ui_schema, status) is owned by the backend features table, not the agent.

post.description: Triggers autonomous agent execution loop and streams response packets via Server-Sent Events. The stream emits HarnessPacket JSON objects, one per line, prefixed with 'data: '. The connection remains open until the mission completes or is aborted.
